name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 4 - Am 60
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 4c. Underlines that the experience and threat assessments of Member States that have for decades warned against Russian imperialism, particularly Poland and the Baltic States, must be taken seriously in shaping European security policy; stresses that deterrence, resilience, strong national defence capabilities, secure critical infrastructure and unwavering support for states threatened or attacked by Russia must take precedence over short-term economic interests or attempts to accommodate the Kremlin; concludes that defending European democracy requires confronting the source of the threat rather than repeating policies that have underestimated it;
